title: Claude CLI
purpose: Runs the Claude CLI worker for delegated coding and review tasks.
description: Agent of Intelligent Home - AI Layer. Answers general questions and summarizes text by running the Claude Code CLI (print mode, all tools off) with a login that the owner creates inside this add-on. No API key. Weekly usage gate and daily cap. Text is scrubbed of personal data first. No Home Assistant access. Maps no folders.
